name: Psaltery phase-rain
desc: Sibling to the shimmer: two identical bowed-psaltery cells, one a hair faster (fast 64/63), slide out of phase and slowly re-lock every 63 cycles in a Reich interference pattern — a liquid downpour of glass rather than a sparse glint.

cut.doc: lpf center Hz — the swell orbits around this

code.sparse: note("<[e5 b5 g#5 e6] [f#5 b5 e6 g#5]>").add(note(${root})).s("psaltery_bow").attack(.1).release(.6).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(28)).lpq(1).delay(".4:.375:.4").gain(${gain}).room(${room}).orbit(7).play()
code.full: stack(note("e5 b5 g#5 e6").s("psaltery_bow").attack(.1).release(.6), note("e5 b5 g#5 e6").s("psaltery_bow").attack(.1).release(.6).fast(64/63)).add(note(${root})).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.5).slow(24)).lpq(1).delay(".5:.375:.45").pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(22)).gain(${gain}).shape(.1).room(${room}).orbit(7).play()
code.peak: stack(note("e5 b5 g#5 e6 f#5 b5").s("psaltery_bow").attack(.08).release(.5), note("e5 b5 g#5 e6 f#5 b5").s("psaltery_bow").attack(.08).release(.5).fast(64/63)).add(note(${root})).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.9).slow(16)).lpq(1).off(3/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.35)).delay(".5:.1875:.5").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(18)).gain(${gain}).shape(.12).room(${room}).orbit(7).play()
